Get key

  1. Click Get key

    Opens the key system in a new tab.

  2. Click through the steps

    Linkvertise, LootLabs and a couple more. Just click through them.

Keys are HWID locked. One key = one device. Sharing your key = blacklist, no second chances.

Key not working or blacklisted by mistake? Open a ticket in #tickets

Executors

Don't have one yet? Here's what the community uses.

What is an executor? An executor is what you use to execute a script — the ones we make. You need one to run FireHub. Pick the one for your device below.

These are the official links. Any other website or "free executor" upload is fake and probably a virus — don't get scammed.

Delta Official

iOS & Android

The most used mobile executor. Works on iPhone and Android without jailbreak.

deltaexploits.gg — Android version deltaexploits.gg — iOS version discord.gg/deltax — official Discord

Real Official

Windows

Windows executor. Download it from their official site or get help in their Discord.

projectreal.gg — official website discord.gg/projectreal — official Discord

Opiumware Official

macOS

Mac executor. Join their official Discord to download it.

discord.gg/opiumware — official Discord

Requirements

  • At least 1,000 subscribers.
  • Videos that actually get views — we check your last few uploads.

How it works

  1. Say hi

    Message us on Discord and we will send your key.

  2. Make your video

    Show FireHub the way you would show any script.

  3. Send us the link

    Drop the video in our Discord DMs once it is up.

    We pay out based on the views your video reaches.
